## 5 Element 17's one route: the open warehouse-reality gaps, served from the read model and from nothing else.

It is the resolver's screen and it has no other verb — no resolve, no close, no dismiss, no acknowledge. Closing an issue is a fact of the resume command on the processing resource (registers D7, D8), so this class holds the projection and no write model at all, and a route that would close one cannot be added here without adding a command no source names. The collection is unpaginated like the orders list: one items envelope, no parameter (element 11 D-11-5).
